title: TESS transit candidates 2026: TIC 402710280, TIC 324429952, TIC 89247735 and TIC 455017950
description: Transit timing, light-curve tables, false-positive checks, TRICERATOPS runs and predicted transit times for four transit candidates found in TESS full-frame images: TIC 402710280 (Gaia DR3 5828441289812582400; P = 36.34005 d, depth about 1680 ppm, 5.3 h, transit-timing variations up to 29 min; two archival HARPS epochs), TIC 324429952 (Gaia DR3 6416596855786566528; P = 42.37574 d, depth about 1500 ppm), TIC 89247735 (Gaia DR3 6708071581514074368, SCR J1820-4533; P = 18.32317 d, dilution-corrected depth 1.13-1.22 %, 4.5 h, Rp about 8.7 Earth radii with the stellar radius from an SED fit) and TIC 455017950 (HD 134147, HIP 74344, Gaia DR3 5825217968423162752; P = 40.60565 d, dilution-corrected depth about 1310 ppm, 4.7 h, Rp about 3.2 Earth radii; SOAR speckle limits from the literature). The tables are recomputed from public MAST, Gaia and ESO archive products by the scripts in the repository. AI-produced, not peer reviewed; the candidates are not confirmed.
notes: Not peer reviewed. Produced by AI models under the direction of the repository owner; see AI_DISCLOSURE.md. Data, figures and text: CC BY 4.0; scripts: MIT.
